title: "Recent Files" in Application Launcher and KRunner contain entries, that no longer exist, and is slow to pick up new entries.
line: KRunner no longer offers recent files that have since been renamed or deleted.
explanation: The Recent Files runner keeps one activity-stats ResultModel and reuses it for every query that starts with the previous one, even across KRunner sessions. The stats library only checks for missing files when the model loads, so after a rename or delete the reused model kept the old path and KRunner offered a file that no longer exists (opening it fails). The runner now skips results whose local file doesn't exist; the query is already limited to local paths.

commits.message:
runners/recentdocuments: skip files that no longer exist

The runner keeps its activity stats model across queries, so a file that
was renamed or deleted after it was opened kept being offered under Recent
Files and failed to open. Skip results whose file no longer exists.

BUG: 506792

media.caption: Master: after renaming very-specific-filename.txt to very-specific-filename-changed.txt, KRunner still offers the old, non-existent name under Recent Files
With the fix, same steps: only the existing renamed file is shown (via Documents), no stale Recent Files entry
